svg.title: Inbox prompt flow
svg.desc: The native composer submits a question through the Embedded companion's private Unix socket. Admission requires a ready generator, resolves the authorized focus and freezes fresh or recorded observations. A separate local journal supplies bounded historical evidence. The leased executor publishes Working and Thinking, then saves the selected plan and its instruction. During Writing, the negotiated generator uses approved options and can return provisional text. Publication verifies the reply under the active lease and revisions. Inbox recovers stages and replies by event cursor. Jobs and Inbox can also request a separate read-only related-activity lookup.
